notes.title: Update Patch - Japanese Language Support and Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we're happy to announce that we're adding japanese language support with the new update, along with several bugfixes. Here's a complete list of features and fixes for this patch:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Japanese Language support added
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] An issue with the Harbinger darkling that would occasionally cause it to become invulnerable has been corrected.
[*] An error while loading global stats on the in-game leaderboard popup has been corrected.
[*] An issue with the Portal Gems that would occasionally cause a level not to end has been corrected.
[*] An issue that would cause the wrong achievement to be unlocked when defeating Olmieth with a 3-star rank has been corrected.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Patch - Bugfix
notes.notes:
Hey guys, just a heads-up to those of you who have been running into troubles with the game, the newest patch is already up and fixes the following bug:
[list]
[*] Fix for the profile creation/selection issue.
[/list]
If you guys run into anything else, just post it on the community hub and we'll look into it as soon as possible!
